subject: Vendor onboarding: PO assignment & itemized spend-cap corrections
messages:
From: QuillCloud Procurement <procurement@quillcloud.com>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 29 May 2026 09:12:00 -07:00
Subject: Vendor onboarding: PO assignment & itemized spend-cap corrections

Hi Hannah + Marissa,

Thanks for the quick onboarding call this morning. We've attached our completed onboarding form and the latest PO line table — there are a couple of clarifications we need before finance issues a final PO number:

- The prod mapping shows two line items for "Inference GPU Hours" that should be consolidated into a single SKU.
- Our procurement team needs a provisional PO number to start internal approvals; final PO will be issued after Redwood confirms spend cap and the consolidated SKU.
- We have a temporary spend cap of $60k for June while we finalize SOW. Can that be reflected in any provisional PO?

Attached: QuillCloud_Onboarding_Form.pdf, PO_matrix_v2.csv

Please advise next steps and who on your end owns the provisional PO allocations.

Best,
Procurement Team
QuillCloud
procurement@quillcloud.com

From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.com>
To: QuillCloud Procurement <procurement@quillcloud.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 29 May 2026 11:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Vendor onboarding: PO assignment & itemized spend-cap corrections

Hi QuillCloud team,

Thanks — received both files. Quick responses below, and steps we will take from Redwood: 

1) SKU consolidation: Marissa will own the line-item cleanup with finance and vendor ops. We will produce a cleaned PO matrix (single "Inference GPU Hours" SKU) and share as PO_matrix_v3.csv by EOD Monday.
2) Provisional PO: We can issue a provisional PO number (PROV-QC-451) to unblock your internal approvals. That will be a soft allocation tied to the $60,000 June spend cap you noted. Final PO number will replace the provisional one once the SOW and final line items are confirmed.
3) Spend cap: We'll reflect the $60k provisional cap in the allocation and add a note on overage routing — any overrun will pause billing until approvals are complete. If you need auto-escalation, let us know and we can add a backstop.

Action items for QuillCloud: please confirm which of the two GPU line entries should be the master (A or B in PO_matrix_v2.csv). Also sign the onboarding checklist and return.

Attachments: redwood_onboard_checklist.xlsx (fillable)

Onwards: Marissa will take point and loop in finance for the provisional PO issuance. Karthik — I flagged this with you for any spend-cap policy exceptions; please advise if $60k needs product approval.

Thanks,
Hannah
Hannah Schmitt
Head of Strategic Accounts | Redwood Inference

From: Lina Gomez <lina.gomez@vendorco.com>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.com>, QuillCloud Procurement <procurement@quillcloud.com>
Date: Mon, 01 Jun 2026 10:17:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Vendor onboarding: PO assignment & itemized spend-cap corrections

Hi all,

We're QuillCloud's vendor admin (Lina from VendorCo) — I took a pass at the PO_matrix and attached our suggested cleanup (QuillCloud_PO_Rates.xlsx). Recommendations:

- Consolidate line 3 and 4 into a single "Inference GPU Hours" SKU, unit price unchanged.
- Move the monthly monitoring fee from a separate line into the bundled support SKU to keep billing simple.
- Please confirm that provisional PO PROV-QC-451 will allow us to invoice in June up to the $60k cap.

If PROV-QC-451 is good, we'll submit our internal invoice routing under that number and start delivering.

Attachments: QuillCloud_PO_Rates.xlsx

Thanks,
Lina Gomez
Vendor Operations | VendorCo
Lina.Gomez@vendorco.com

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: QuillCloud Procurement <procurement@quillcloud.com>, Lina Gomez <lina.gomez@vendorco.com>
Cc: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 02 Jun 2026 16:45:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Vendor onboarding: PO assignment & itemized spend-cap corrections

Hi QuillCloud / Lina — short status update and confirmation:

- Line items: we've accepted the consolidation suggested by VendorCo. PO_matrix_v3.csv is attached in the hub (link below) and matches QuillCloud_PO_Rates.xlsx.
- Provisional PO: PROV-QC-451 has been created in our system and mapped to the temporary spend cap of $60,000 for June. This will allow VendorCo to submit invoices referencing PROV-QC-451; finance will hold final payment until SOW and final PO are issued.
- Next steps: we will convert PROV-QC-451 -> PO-2026-00988 once the signed onboarding checklist and final SOW are in place. Please return the signed redwood_onboard_checklist.xlsx and confirm the master SKU (we selected the first GPU row by default).

Attachments sent to your hub folder: PO_matrix_v3.csv (cleaned), onboarding checklist (signed template attached for convenience).

Hub links: https://docs.google.com/document/d/1onboard (cleaned PO), HubSpot deal: https://app.hubspot.com/deal/67890
DocuSign (SOW placeholder): https://redwood.app/docusign/abc123

If you'd like, we can schedule a 20-minute sync to walk the finance team through the provisional process; otherwise we'll assume the consolidation is approved and proceed to final PO issuance after the checklist is returned.

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
Vendor Ops Lead | Redwood Inference
Attachments: PO_matrix_v3.csv (hub), redwood_onboard_checklist_filled.xlsx (stub)
